link.$description: Two link levels, shared by every product. Inline: a link inside a sentence, at the sentence's size. Quiet: a side trip or a small control (View task, Show full year, sources), one step smaller and gray. Each theme sets the colors and the quiet size.

offset.$description: Space between text and underline, so descenders stay readable.

strength.$description: Underline opacity at rest, as a percent of the link color. Full strength on hover.
